title: Bark Fluent
description: A snap-on smart collar that translates every bark into perfect spoken English, so your dog can finally confess its love, its grudges, and its plans.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-chipper
lines.text: Snap on the collar and every bark becomes perfect English! <p:0.2> Bark Fluent. Hear your dog confess its love, its grudges, its plans.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: May translate thoughts you were not meant to hear. <p:0> May fuse to the spine. <p:0> Do not let it address other dogs. <p:0> Side effects include household coups and one articulate hamster. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
